FULL TEXT:
University Business School
Panjab University Regional Centre, Ludhiana
Dated: 22nd August 2025
Advertisement for the Post of Guest Faculty (01)
Management/Commerce (01)
Applications are invited from eligible candidates for the post of one (01) Guest Faculty to
teach at the University Business School, PU Regional Centre, Ludhiana, for the odd Semester
(Academic Session 2025-26).
Educational Qualifications:
a) Master’s Degree in Business Management/Administration/with a good academic record as
defined by the University with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/PwD) or an equivalent
grade in a point scale wherever the grading system is followed.
b) In addition to fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National
Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC, CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC,
like SLET/SET.
c) Candidates who are, or have been, awarded a Ph.D. Degree in accordance with the University
Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of Ph.D. Degree)
Regulations, 2009 or 2016, shall be exempted from the requirement of the minimum
eligibility condition of NET/SLET/SET for recruitment and appointment of Assistant
Professor or equivalent positions in Universities/Colleges/Institutions.
Desirable: Ph.D. Degree in Business Management/ Administration/ Commerce and teaching
experience in Graduate/Post-Graduate classes in the respective areas.
Important Instructions:
1. Applicants are required to complete the application form (pages 1 to 9) for Assistant
Professors, which is available on the Panjab University, Chandigarh website. Follow the link
for download: http://jobs.puchd.ac.in/forms.php.
2. The application form, completed in all respects and accompanied by self-attested copies of all
supporting documents, must reach the office of The Director, Panjab University Regional Centre,
Ludhiana-141001 by 02nd September, 2025 up to 4:00 p.m.
3. The shortlisted candidates will be informed about the interview date and timings via email only. Please
note that no travel allowance or dearness allowance (TA/DA) will be provided for attending the
interview.
4. The selected candidate must undertake that he/she will not draw any fellowship, stipend, or financial
assistance from any agency and will continue to adhere to this while teaching at UBS, Ludhiana.
5. The above assignment is on a lecture basis with an honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per lecture with
an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.
6. Working hours for the appointee will be 9.00 am to 5.00 pm (Monday to Friday).
Sd/-
Director
PU Regional Centre, Ludhiana
